datasets.official_status: THIRD-PARTY. Not an official NFL publication.
datasets.official_cross_check: Every game is compared to official NFL.com scores by engine/verify_official.py; see data/empirical/official_verification.csv

conventions_verified.spread_line: positive = HOME team favored (documented upstream, confirmed empirically: corr(result, spread_line)=+0.43)

datasets.limitation: No official or verified sportsbook PLAYER PROP LINES exist in this dataset. Prop lines used in analysis are ORIGINATED in-repo as trailing medians and are labelled as such. No ROI is claimed on player props.

closing_lines_note: spread_line/total_line/moneyline fields in games.csv are third-party consensus closing prices. No official league source publishes betting lines. All price-dependent results are flagged accordingly.
license_note: Upstream datasets are community open data. Vendored here for reproducible research with attribution.
